source: packages/cli/test/browser/large-graph-benchmark.mjs; search is timed inside the page from the input event to the DOM commit of the result count (MutationObserver), because frame polling quantizes to ~16.7 ms
method: Interleaved A/B on the same machine and Chromium: Phase 0 (eef84d7f, 48,662 nodes) and the integrated tree (49,096 nodes / 135,463 edges), three runs of three fresh pages each
notes: Earlier frame-polled figures (Phase 0 71 ms, first integrated run 80 ms) differed by one animation frame; the precise A/B shows no regression.
